bio: A modern gastro-bar with the soul of a restaurant located just a few metres from the city’s iconic Plaza Mayor. At Bambú, the open kitchen, traditional cuisine and grilled dishes reinterpreted from a more contemporary perspective are the main highlights, although you’ll also find hints of fusion and strong flavours from other parts of the world. Choose between tapas, half-plates and dishes designed for sharing, alongside an interesting tasting menu. Dishes we can recommend include the classic truffled duck egg, the highly original chicken chilli doughnut, the braised avocado with pipirrana, and the braised Iberian pork cheeks. Unsurprisingly, it is often full every day....
